This event will be held on the following day(s): • Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 12 p.m. • Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 5 p.m. Direct Entry: At the conclusion of each event, prize winners will be directly registered into the $1,600 Mystery Bounty $1,000,000 GTD Poker Tournament. Upon registration, winners will receive a seat assignment, and their chips will be put into play from the start of the event. Entry Fee: $300 Buy-in = $250 (Tournament Prize Pool) + $34 (Tournament Fee) + $16 (Poker Staff Service Charge) Registration: Unlimited re-entry will be available until the start of level 9. Starting Stack: Players will start with 20,000 in tournament chips. Length of Play: 20 minutes per level until completion. Breaks: 10-minute break every 4 levels of play. Players Per Table: Tables will play 9-handed. The Final Table will begin 9-handed. Payouts: The Tournament Prize will be one (1) direct entry seat into the $1,600 Mystery Bounty $1,000,000 GTD Poker Tournament to be held on December 19-21, 2026. The total number of available Tournament Prizes will be based on the total number of Entry Fees received. One (1) Tournament Prize, valued at $1,600, will be generated for every 6.4 Entry Fees received (the “Tournament Prize Formula”).
